svg.metadata: Region coastlines and boundaries from jhellingsdata/map-data CTRY_GB-ENG/WLS/SCT (MIT). Single WGS84 local-equirectangular-fit-v1 projection shared by all polygons and verified markers. Administrative borders are not interpolated.
